info.name: CargoSphere Backend - API Gateway
info.description: Master CargoSphere backend collection. Business requests use the API Gateway at {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080). Run folders in order. Register Client generates fresh runtime values; login requests save client/admin JWTs automatically.

request.description: Checks the API Gateway actuator endpoint.
Public auth-service health endpoint through the gateway.
Public shipment-service health endpoint through the gateway.
Direct health check because the current gateway configuration exposes /api/container-types/** and /api/container-allocations/**, not /api/containers/**.
Public document-service health endpoint through the gateway.
Public payment-service health endpoint through the gateway.
Public audit-service health endpoint through the gateway.
Creates a new CLIENT account and stores clientId. Fresh values are generated before every run.
Logs in the generated client and stores clientToken.
Uses an existing ADMIN account and stores adminId and adminToken.

exec: throw new Error("Set adminEmail and adminPassword in the active CargoSphere Local environment.");

request.description: Lists users. Uses the ADMIN token.
Returns the generated client account.
CLIENT creates a shipment owned by clientId. Saves shipmentId and shipmentNumber.
CLIENT retrieves shipments owned by the current account.
CLIENT retrieves the owned shipment.
CLIENT retrieves the owned shipment by shipment number.
Adds cargo details to the generated shipment and saves cargoDetailId.
Lists cargo details for the generated shipment.
ADMIN updates shipment status. Default shipmentStatus is IN_TRANSIT.
CLIENT retrieves the event history for the owned shipment.
ADMIN lists all shipments.
ADMIN creates a unique container type and saves containerTypeId.

request.description: ADMIN allocates the generated container type to the generated shipment and saves allocationId.
ADMIN lists all allocations.
ADMIN retrieves the generated allocation.
ADMIN lists allocations for the generated shipment.
ADMIN updates notes while retaining the allocation identifiers.

ADMIN lists all documents.
ADMIN retrieves the generated document.
ADMIN lists documents for the generated shipment.
ADMIN verifies or rejects the generated document. Default verificationStatus is VERIFIED.
CLIENT creates a PENDING payment and saves paymentId.

ADMIN lists all payments.
ADMIN retrieves the generated payment.
ADMIN lists payments for the generated shipment.
ADMIN changes the payment to PAID and triggers PAYMENT_COMPLETED audit publication.
ADMIN refunds a PAID payment and triggers PAYMENT_REFUNDED audit publication.
